user.title: Cloudflare account
user.description: Enter a Cloudflare API Token (create one in the Cloudflare dashboard under My Profile > API Tokens). The token needs Zone > DNS > Edit and Zone > Zone > Read permissions for the zones you want to keep up to date. A Global API Key is NOT used here.

record.title: DNS record
record.description: Add a DNS record to keep in sync with your external IP. The record must already exist in the zone (create it once in the Cloudflare dashboard); this integration only updates its content.

abort.already_configured: This Cloudflare token is already configured.

notifications.title: Notification settings
notifications.description: Choose how you want to be notified when a DNS record is updated.

data.notify_persistent: Show a persistent notification in Home Assistant
data.notify_event: Fire a 'cloudflare_multi_updated' event (for your own automations, e.g. a mobile push notification)
data.notify_targets: Send directly to these notify targets (e.g. mobile_app_your_phone) - select one or more, or type a name that isn't listed yet
